title: AFL Brownlow Medal
metaDescription: AFL Brownlow Medal: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Aussie Rules.

overview.about: The Brownlow Medal is Australian rules football's most prestigious individual honour, awarded to the AFL's best and fairest player of the home-and-away season. Decided by umpires' votes and revealed at a glamorous count on the eve of the Grand Final, 'Brownlow night' is a major event in its own right.
overview.nextEvent: The next Brownlow Medal count is held in Melbourne in Grand Final week. Umpire votes from every match are read out round by round in a tense live tally to crown the league's fairest and best player.
